args.query:
SELECT u.user_id, u.signup_date::date AS signup_date, MIN(v.completed_date) AS first_completed_date, CAST(MIN(v.completed_date) - u.signup_date AS DOUBLE) AS days_to_first
FROM dim_users u
JOIN fct_value_moments v USING (user_id)
WHERE u.is_internal = FALSE
  AND u.signup_date >= '2026-04-01'
  AND u.signup_date <= '2026-06-30'
  AND v.completed_date >= u.signup_date
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.signup_date
HAVING MIN(v.completed_date) IS NOT NULL;
